summary: This is an XML document representing a bookstore with books organized by category. Each book contains metadata like its title and language attribute. The HTML comments with 'highlight-next-line' are markers used by documentation tools or syntax highlighters to draw attention to specific elements.

explanations.1: This is a special comment that tells documentation generators or code highlighters to emphasize the very next line of code.
explanations.4: The 'category' is an attribute of the book element that describes what type of book it is; in this case, it's a cooking book.
explanations.6: The 'lang' attribute on the title element specifies that the title text is in English; attributes provide extra information about an element.
